ModMetaData.name: Homesteader
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Grow it, put it by, live off the land. Homesteader is the farmstead kit: tribal drying from day one, dairy and hearth meals, orchard and bees, wells and irrigation, cool cellars, livestock, and off-grid power.
Homesteaders scenario included. Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save. Before removing: deconstruct buildings and use up or sell its items.
Full notes: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/homesteader Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
